address: Carretera de El Barco, Hoyos del Espino, 05634, Spain
bio: Found on the first floor of the hotel La Mira de Gredos, this restaurant is furnished with a large windowed room, to marvel at the Sierra de Gredos as you eat. Out of the kitchen comes an updated traditional cuisine, with a choice of à la carte service and two set menus (Traditional and Tasting). Dishes not to be missed? Try the popular Patatas revolconas, with paprika from La Vera and pork crackling, or the very tasty white bean stew from El Barco with its traditional sacramentos (cured meats and sausages)....
